origin.description: Writes a data frame to a SAS transport file.
origin.usage: write_xpt(data, path, version = 8, name = NULL, label = attr(data, "label"), adjust_tz = TRUE)

arguments.name: name
arguments.text: Member name. Version 5 allows 8 characters and version 8 allows 32. The default is the file stem.

arguments.name: adjust_tz
arguments.text: When true, a zoned datetime is written as the same clock time in UTC.

origin.details: This is the supported way to write SAS data. write_sas remains only as a deprecated sas7bdat writer.
origin.example:
tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".xpt")
write_xpt(tibble::tibble(num = c(1, 2)), tmp, version = 8, name = "T")
print(read_xpt(tmp)$num)
unlink(tmp)

translation.description: Writes a data frame to a SAS transport file.
translation.usage: write_xpt(data, path, version=8, name=None, label=None, adjust_tz=True)

arguments.name: name
arguments.text: Member name. Version 5 allows 8 characters and version 8 allows 32. The default is the file stem.

arguments.name: adjust_tz
arguments.text: When true, a zoned datetime is written as the same clock time in UTC.

translation.details: This is the supported way to write SAS data. write_sas remains only as a deprecated sas7bdat writer.
translation.example:
import os, tempfile
from haven import read_xpt, write_xpt
from haven.labelled import Vector
from tibble import new_tibble
path = tempfile.mktemp(suffix=".xpt")
write_xpt(new_tibble([Vector([1.0, 2.0], "double")], nrow=2, names=["num"]), path, version=8, name="T")
print(read_xpt(path).columns[0].values)
os.remove(path)
